# PGBoxDB - Lightweight Postgres for AI Agents

> PGBoxDB is a lightweight PostgreSQL-compatible database runtime written in Rust. Run thousands of isolated, disposable databases in one process. Designed for AI agents, CI, testing, and local development.

Website: https://pgboxdb.com
GitHub: https://github.com/pgrundev/pgboxdb
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pgboxdb
Latest release: v0.2.0 (https://github.com/pgrundev/pgboxdb/releases/tag/v0.2.0)
License: AGPL-3.0

## Quick Start (Recommended)

The simplest way to install and run PGBoxDB:

```bash
npx pgboxdb@latest
```

This installs PGBoxDB, starts the runtime, creates an `app` database, and prints its PostgreSQL connection URL.

No Docker, Rust, or system PostgreSQL installation required.

## What's New in v0.2.0

- First release under the PGBoxDB name. The command and the npm package are `pgboxdb`, environment variables are `PGBOXDB_*`, the data home is `~/.pgboxdb`, the project file is `.pgboxdb.toml`.
- `pgboxdb top`: a read-only live terminal monitor of every database, grouped by project, Git branch and agent session. `pgboxdb --json top --snapshot` gives one snapshot as JSON.
- Existing installations of the previous product are never lost: `pgboxdb migrate` moves them (a dry run by default, `--apply` to do it, `--rollback` to undo).

## Installation Methods

### 1. NPX - Zero Setup

```bash
npx pgboxdb@latest
```

Recommended for trying PGBoxDB immediately.

### 2. NPM - Global Installation

```bash
npm install -g pgboxdb
pgboxdb run
```

Recommended for frequent local development.

### 3. Shell - macOS and Linux

```bash
curl -fsSL https://pgboxdb.com/install | sh
pgboxdb run
```

Recommended when Node.js is unavailable. The installer verifies the SHA-256 of the release tarball.

### 4. Claude Code - Native Plugin

Inside Claude Code:

```text
/plugin marketplace add pgrundev/pgboxdb-plugin
/plugin install pgboxdb@pgboxdb-plugin
```

Then ask Claude:

"Set up isolated PGBoxDB databases for this project."

The plugin provides agent instructions. The database runtime is installed when needed, subject to user permissions.

### 5. Cursor, Codex and Other AI Agents

Install the PGBoxDB agent skill:

```bash
npx skills add pgrundev/pgboxdb --skill pgboxdb
```

Then ask your agent:

"Use PGBoxDB for isolated development databases. Set up this project."

The skill helps the agent configure PGBoxDB and database isolation.

### 6. Docker - Build Locally

```bash
git clone https://github.com/pgrundev/pgboxdb.git
cd pgboxdb
docker build -t pgboxdb:dev .
docker run --rm -p 5432:5432 \
  -e PGBOXDB_PASSWORD=secret \
  -v pgboxdbdata:/var/lib/pgboxdb \
  pgboxdb:dev
```

Recommended for container-based environments.

### 7. Build from Source

```bash
git clone https://github.com/pgrundev/pgboxdb.git
cd pgboxdb
cargo build --release --locked --bin postgres
```

Requires the pinned Rust toolchain, RE2, and PostgreSQL 18 build/client dependencies. See docs/pgboxdb/local-dev/build-from-source.md.

## Basic Usage

```bash
# Start PGBoxDB and get a ready `app` database
pgboxdb run

# Create a database
pgboxdb create myapp

# Get a connection URL
pgboxdb url myapp

# Create an isolated agent branch (expires after 2h by default)
pgboxdb branch myapp agent-001

# Create a temporary clone
pgboxdb clone myapp test-001 --ttl 30m

# Run any command with its own branch in DATABASE_URL
pgboxdb agent exec -- bin/rails test

# One database per Git branch, automatically
pgboxdb git init

# Watch every database live
pgboxdb top

# List databases
pgboxdb ls

# Stop runtime
pgboxdb stop
```

Commands can also run through `npx pgboxdb`.

## Guidance for AI Agents

- Prefer `npx pgboxdb@latest` for the simplest setup.
- Prefer the native plugin for Claude Code.
- Prefer the PGBoxDB skill for Cursor, Codex, and other supported agents.
- Use a separate database branch for each independent agent.
- Use TTLs for temporary databases.
- Use `pgboxdb --json ls` for machine-readable database listings.
- Use PostgreSQL-compatible clients and connection URLs.
- Never use PGBoxDB as the production source of truth.
- Do not copy sensitive production data without appropriate sanitization.
- Request permission before installing software or changing project configuration.

## Platform Support

- macOS: Apple Silicon
- Linux: x86-64 and ARM64
- Intel macOS: not currently supported

## Limitations

PGBoxDB is an early release for disposable workloads, not a production PostgreSQL replacement.

- Not crash-safe under the ephemeral runtime profile
- Databases share one runtime failure domain
- PostgreSQL C extensions are not supported
- Copy-on-write cloning depends on filesystem capabilities
